application_classification.grothendieck_folded_theta: authority square commutes only with the explicit moving-endpoint seam/reflection coherence cell; result remains readout authority
application_classification.kitaev_logical_to_five_rail: no composable authority map; conditional logical synthesis and rail-support evidence do not supply native coupler authority or encoded intertwining

descent_verdict: Flat local presentation coherence is necessary but insufficient: the local grants must glue effectively and uniquely to a global authority grant, remain invariant under atlas refinement, and survive deletion only when an independent source reconstruction remains.

admission_review_upgrades_operative_auth.description: A merits review silently promotes a constructor claim to executor authority.

appeal_uses_uncertified_root.description: The appeal panel is named but its authority root has no certification.

arbitrary_column_opens_rival_challenge.description: A new response column opens a challenge without any admitted constructor-level rival packet.

authorized_gauge_but_incomplete_quotient.description: The stabilizer is source-authorized, but quotienting leaves a nonzero ambiguity kernel.

cached_decision_survives_as_live_authori.description: A cached admission retains prospective standing after its review root is revoked and before replay.

cached_output_retains_authority_after_so.description: A cached result is incorrectly treated as retaining authority after its constructor is deleted.

cached_witness_not_recomputable.description: A stored coherence certificate survives, but the declared source can no longer regenerate it.

completion_ports_to_constructor.description: A completed readout and executable observation ports are laundered into constructor authority.

deletion_survival_without_source_reconst.description: The process is claimed to survive deletion of Bprime without a surviving source-derived reconstruction.

effective_descent_with_hidden_ambiguity.description: A global grant is reconstructed but a nonzero ambiguity kernel makes it nonunique.

evidence_preserving_base_change_loses_au.description: Chart evidence survives base change while source authority does not.

factorization_dependent_composite.description: Both local factorizations exist, but their result grants live on different evidence domains.

faithfulness_plus_support_to_observer.description: Algebraic faithfulness and physical support are laundered into observer authority.

finite_audit_claims_universal_explanatio.description: A full-rank finite candidate audit is silently extrapolated to all possible mechanisms.

finite_rival_protocol_claims_closed_worl.description: A repaired finite family is declared immune to every future ungenerated rival.

flat_atlas_but_noneffective_descent.description: All overlap cells are flat, but the local grants do not reconstruct a global authority grant.

flat_replay_atlas_withholds_standing.description: All valid replay paths agree but the contract arbitrarily withholds restored prospective standing.

gauge_copy_admitted_as_new_rival.description: An authorized gauge copy is mislabeled as a physically distinct rival mechanism.

higher_appeal_cell_selects_truth.description: The higher appeal cell claims authority to overwrite disagreement and select mechanism truth.

incumbent_is_sole_rival_reviewer.description: The incumbent mechanism controls the only admission vote on its own rival.

interventions_leave_rival_mechanism_kern.description: Two valid probes leave one inequivalent candidate mechanism unresolved.

new_rival_but_old_authority_retained.description: An unresolved new candidate is admitted while the old identification authority is silently retained.

noninvertible_presentation_cell.description: A one-way adapter is mislabeled as an equivalence of explanatory presentations.

pairwise_cells_nontrivial_atlas_holonomy.description: Every presentation change is locally valid, but direct and two-step re-encoding disagree around the atlas triangle.

pairwise_valid_triple_incoherent.description: Every pairwise composition remains valid, but the triple associator has nonzero defect.

port_incomplete_rival_admitted.description: A proposed mechanism is admitted despite lacking predictions on every already-declared intervention port.

proposer_identity_changes_decision.description: The identical content-addressed rival packet receives a different decision under a different proposer name.

readout_to_source_provenance_cycle.description: The terminal readout is allowed to regenerate the source constructor, producing circular explanatory provenance.

refinement_changes_reconstruction.description: The coarse and refined presentation atlases reconstruct inequivalent global grants.

remove_B_without_direct_source_grant.description: Removing B destroys the composite because no independently authorized direct A-to-C grant remains.

representation_change_strengthens_author.description: The alternative presentation silently promotes a readout process to selector authority.

representation_change_without_coherence.description: Changing B to Bprime preserves the boundary process signature but supplies no source-derived coherence cell.

review_charter_claims_truth_selection.description: A procedural review charter expands into authority to select the true mechanism.

review_criteria_fitted_after_response.description: Admission criteria are selected only after reviewers inspect the rival response column.

review_replay_substitutes_new_packet.description: Temporal replay silently changes the content-addressed evidence packet.

review_replay_uses_revoked_root.description: Replay at time 30 reuses a root revoked at time 25.

review_root_has_no_external_charter.description: A reviewer root is presented without an issuing source charter.

review_root_self_authorizes.description: A review authority root cites itself as its own charter and provenance.

review_roots_share_hidden_controller.description: Distinct merits roots descend from one controlling ancestor.

reviewers_share_one_authority_root.description: Two nominal reviewers derive authority from the same source and are falsely counted as independent.

revocation_erases_review_history.description: Revoking a root deletes the fact that its earlier valid review occurred.

rival_repair_uses_target_fitted_probe.description: The new rival is separated by a discriminator designed from its desired output rather than the source grammar.

rival_reverse_engineered_from_incumbent_.description: Delta is admitted although its constructor was fitted from the incumbent target responses.

rival_review_has_no_independent_appeal.description: The initial reviewers are also the entire appeal panel.

root_revocation_is_backdated.description: The revocation is placed before the original review, invalidating its claimed authorization interval.

source_perturbation_leaves_coherence_ine.description: The alleged source is perturbed but the coherence witness is merely replayed unchanged.

standing_restored_without_replay.description: Prospective authority is restored without completing a new review.

successor_replay_paths_disagree.description: Two independently valid successor atlases return different dispositions while standing is declared restored.

target_fitted_coherence_witness.description: The presentation equivalence is chosen only after inspecting the desired target readout.

target_fitted_discriminator_ports.description: The intervention ports separate candidates only because they were chosen after seeing the desired mechanism.

target_intervention_rewrites_coherence.description: Changing the desired readout retroactively changes an upstream coherence witness.

temporal_path_comparison_is_fitted.description: The rule for comparing successor replay paths is chosen after their dispositions are known.

temporal_paths_share_review_root.description: Two nominal replay paths share a controlling merits root and are falsely treated as independent.

two_readouts_to_selector.description: Two valid readout grants are laundered into selector authority.

unauthorized_global_stabilizer.description: A hidden automorphism preserves every local readout but is not authorized by the source grammar.

identification_verdict: Interventions identify a mechanism only relative to a declared candidate family: the exact observation matrix must have no kernel beyond source-authorized gauge, the ports must be source-derived, and finite rank may not be extrapolated to a universal explanatory claim.
intervention_verdict: A provenance graph becomes explanatory only when source interventions regenerate downstream coherence, target interventions leave upstream authority fixed, and source deletion revokes authority even if cached output persists.
open_world_verdict: A new rival that enlarges the non-gauge kernel suspends identification authority. Authority returns only after a newly source-derived discriminator makes the extended family jointly faithful; no finite repair closes the space of future rivals.
provenance_verdict: Even effective descent is explanatory only when every coherence and gluing witness is generated along an acyclic source-to-readout provenance order, independently of the desired target, and can be regenerated in a source-preserving replay.
representation_change_verdict: A claimed explanation survives removal or replacement of B only when the induced A-to-C grant keeps its process signature and any non-identical presentation is joined by a source-derived invertible natural coherence cell. Otherwise it explains a presentation.
review_root_verdict: Reviewer independence is derived from externally chartered, revocable procedural roots with no shared controlling ancestry and a challenge-standing ceiling. Distinct labels are insufficient, self-certification is circular, and appeal requires its own certified jurisdiction.
rival_admission_verdict: A rival may enter the explanatory competition only through an independently generated constructor grammar, total predictions on existing ports, a non-gauge difference witness, and admission before response selection. Gauge copies and incomplete speculations cannot manufacture challenges.
rival_governance_verdict: Rival admission is a separate, content-addressed authority process: proposer and incumbent are excluded from merits adjudication, independent reviewer roots and a disjoint appeal path are required, proposer identity cannot change the decision, and review grants challenge standing without upgrading operative authority.
temporal_atlas_verdict: Replay is path-independent only when disjoint certified successor atlases reviewing the same frozen packet under a precommitted comparison law agree. Disagreement is governance holonomy that suspends standing; a higher appeal cell may compare or restart procedure but cannot overwrite it into truth.
temporal_authority_verdict: Revocation preserves the historical review record but suspends prospective challenge standing. Live authority returns only after the identical frozen evidence packet is replayed through roots certified at replay time; cached decisions are not continuing grants.
verdict: Authority grants form a partial category only on matching authority kind, variance, endpoints, and evidenced domains. Transport preserves kind, intersection restricts domains, extension requires fresh authority, and both triple composition and representation change require explicit zero-defect coherence.
